message.content: /deep-research Which, if any, of the countries that met WHO air quality standards in the IQ Air Quality Reports 2023 also had 2022 EPI sanitation / drinking water and water resources ranks of 1?

content.text: I'll research this multi-step question by finding the IQ Air 2023 countries meeting WHO standards, then cross-referencing with 2022 EPI water/sanitation rankings.

tasks.goal: Find the list of countries that met WHO air quality standards (PM2.5 ≤ 5 µg/m³) in the IQ Air World Air Quality Report 2023
tasks.context: Need the specific countries from the 2023 IQ Air report that achieved the WHO annual PM2.5 guideline of 5 µg/m³. Look for the report's country/region ranking table or list of compliant countries.

tasks.goal: Find the 2022 Environmental Performance Index (EPI) rankings for Sanitation & Drinking Water and Water Resources, specifically which countries ranked #1 in each category
tasks.context: The 2022 EPI report has separate indicator rankings. Need the countries that scored rank 1 in both 'Sanitation & Drinking Water' and 'Water Resources' indicator categories.

Based on the research, here's the answer:

## Countries Meeting All Criteria

**Only 1 country: Finland**

---

### Cross-Reference Analysis

| IQ Air 2023 WHO-Compliant Countries (PM2.5 ≤ 5 µg/m³) | 2022 EPI Sanitation & Drinking Water Rank 1 | 2022 EPI Water Resources Rank 1 | **Both EPI Ranks = 1** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Australia | No | No | No |
| Estonia | No | No | No |
| **Finland** | **Yes (tied 100.00)** | **Yes (tied 100.00)** | **YES** |
| Grenada | No | No | No |
| Iceland | Yes (tied 100.00) | No | No |
| Mauritius | No | No | No |
| New Zealand | No | No | No |

---

### Key Findings

- **7 sovereign countries** met WHO PM2.5 standards in IQ Air 2023: Australia, Estonia, Finland, Grenada, Iceland, Mauritius, New Zealand [1][2]
- **2022 EPI Sanitation & Drinking Water** rank 1 (tied): Norway, Switzerland, Netherlands, Finland, UK, Iceland [3]
- **2022 EPI Water Resources** rank 1 (tied): Denmark, Finland [3]
- **Finland** is the only country appearing on all three lists

---

## Sources

[1] IQAir 2023 World Air Quality Report press release — https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/2023-iqair-world-air-quality-report-finds-only-7-countries-meet-who-pm2-5-air-pollution-guideline-302088419.html

[2] Full 2023 IQAir report (Greenpeace-hosted PDF) — https://www.greenpeace.org/static/planet4-india-stateless/2024/03/44a856c8-2023_world_air_quality_report.pdf

[3] EPI 2022 component rankings — https://epi.yale.edu/epi-results/2022/component/h2o (Sanitation & Drinking Water) and https://epi.yale.edu/epi-results/2022/component/wrs (Water Resources)
